title: Cell-type-specific transposon demethylation and TAD remodeling in aging mouse brain.
authors: Zeng, Qiurui; Wang, Wenliang; Tian, Wei; Klein, Amit; Bartlett, Anna; Liu, Hanqing; Nery, Joseph R; Castanon, Rosa G; Osteen, Julia; Johnson, Nicholas D; Ding, Wubin; Chen, Huaming; Altshul, Jordan; Kenworthy, Mia; Valadon, Cynthia; Owens, William; Wu, Zhanghao; Amaral, Maria Luisa; Zemke, Nathan R; Song, Yuru; Baez-Becerra, Cindy Tatiana; Cho, Silvia; Chen, Chumo; Willier, Jackson; Cao, Stella; Rink, Jonathan; Lee, Jasper; Barcoma, Ariana; Arzavala, Jessica; Emerson, Nora; Lu, Yuancheng Ryan; Ren, Bing; Behrens, M Margarita; Ecker, Joseph R
one_liner_zh: 该研究构建衰老小鼠脑的单细胞甲基化与染色质构象图谱，并用深度学习预测年龄相关基因表达，但核心是表观遗传图谱而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅涉及CTCF结合位点，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: Aging is a major risk factor for neurodegenerative diseases, yet the underlying epigenetic mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we generated a comprehensive single-nucleus cell atlas of brain aging across multiple brain regions, comprising 132,551 single-cell methylomes and 72,666 joint chromatin conformation-methylome nuclei. Integration with companion transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility data yielded a cross-modality taxonomy of 36 major cell types. We observed that transposable element (TE) methylation alone distinguished age groups, showing cell-type-specific genome-wide demethylation. Chromatin conformation analysis demonstrated age-related increases in topologically associated domain (TAD) boundary strength with enhanced accessibility at CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) binding sites. Spatial transcriptomics across 895,296 cells revealed regional heterogeneity during aging within identical cell types. Finally, we developed deep-learning models that reliably predict age-related gene expression changes using multi-modal epigenetic features, providing mechanistic insights into gene regulation. Age-related comparisons use a 2-month baseline reflecting the late-adolescent/early-young adult stage. This dataset advances our understanding of brain aging and offers potential translational applications.
abstract_zh: 衰老是神经退行性疾病的主要风险因素，但其潜在的表观遗传机制仍不清楚。在此，我们生成了涵盖多个脑区的脑衰老综合单核细胞图谱，包含132,551个单细胞甲基化组和72,666个联合染色质构象-甲基化组核。与配套的转录组和染色质可及性数据整合后，我们得到了36种主要细胞类型的跨模态分类。我们观察到，转座元件（TE）甲基化单独即可区分年龄组，显示出细胞类型特异性的全基因组去甲基化。染色质构象分析表明，年龄相关的拓扑关联域（TAD）边界强度增加，且CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）结合位点的可及性增强。对895,296个细胞的空间转录组学分析揭示了相同细胞类型在衰老过程中的区域异质性。最后，我们开发了深度学习模型，利用多模态表观遗传特征可靠预测年龄相关的基因表达变化，为基因调控提供了机制性见解。年龄相关比较以2个月龄为基线，反映晚期青少年/早期青年阶段。该数据集增进了我们对脑衰老的理解，并提供了潜在的转化应用价值。
